clips.caption:
How you see yourself isn't a small detail. It's the compass that decides which direction your whole life ends up going.

Most people never examine it, because most people never installed it on purpose. It went in early - from people and places you trusted, long before you had any say in the matter. Which is a polite way of saying you were programmed, then put into something close to a trance about it, and never told.

Waking up from that doesn't start with fixing your results. It starts with noticing the belief sitting underneath them - the one you never chose and never once questioned.
